name: get_regime_state
description: Get the current market regime from PRISM's hidden Markov model fitted nightly on 10+ years of official data (equity returns, curve slope, VIX, oil, dollar): probabilities of risk-on / neutral / stress states, current most-likely state, per-state characteristics, expected persistence. source=model; disclose it is a statistical model estimate, not an observation.

name: get_impact_function
description: Get PRISM's estimated response curve of an asset to a 1-sigma shock in a driver variable: posterior mean response at horizons 1-20 days with 68%/95% credible bands, and the validation grade. CONFIRMED = survived FDR-controlled causality testing AND out-of-sample walk-forward validation; HYPOTHESIS = estimated but not validated — ALWAYS state the grade. Example pairs: shock='DCOILWTICO_ret' response='DGS10_diff' (oil to 10Y yield), shock='VIXCLS_diff' response='NASDAQCOM_ret'.

shock.description: Shock variable id, e.g. 'DCOILWTICO_ret' (oil return), 'VIXCLS_diff' (VIX change), or a news factor id like 'war-conflict' once enough factor history exists

name: get_confirmed_regularities
description: List the causal edges (driver leads asset) that PRISM has CONFIRMED: significant under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control across the full hypothesis grid AND positive out-of-sample edge in walk-forward validation. Also reports the count still at HYPOTHESIS grade. An EMPTY confirmed list is a valid honest answer, especially while news-factor history is still accumulating — say so rather than overstating.

name: get_tail_risk
description: Get PRISM's extreme-value-theory tail risk for an asset: GPD (peaks-over-threshold) tail index, VaR and Expected Shortfall at 99% and 99.9%, and a jump-activity indicator. Fitted on 10+ years of daily data. source=model — these are statistical estimates of tail behavior, not guarantees.

asset.description: Asset id: 'NASDAQCOM' (Nasdaq daily returns) or 'DGS10' (10Y yield changes) (Default: 'NASDAQCOM')
